english.title: Drive passenger vehicle fail take daily rest interval of at least 10 hours between 2 working days - Mod Order - domestic
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a passenger vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which section 96 of the Transport Act 1968 and the Drivers' Hours (Passenger and Goods Vehicles)(Modifications) Order 1971 applied, and failed to take an interval for rest between two successive working days of at least ten hours, the interval taken being **(..SPECIFY THE REST INTERVAL TAKEN..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(4) and (11) of the Transport Act 1968.
